name: Waste & Yield CK
description: G32 (K25-08): waste (scrap beralasan, nilai valuasi Odoo) dan yield/varians produksi Central Kitchen dari efn_ck_production. Ambang = nilai PT saat ini. Sumber: view efn_dwh.v_waste_* / v_mo_*.

cards.name: Total nilai waste
cards.description: Nilai valuasi Odoo (efn_waste_value) scrap selesai pada periode.
cards.sql: SELECT sum(waste_value) AS nilai_waste FROM efn_dwh.v_waste_warehouse_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Yield tertimbang
cards.description: Σ hasil aktual / Σ rencana MO selesai x 100 (bukan rata-rata persen).
cards.sql: SELECT if(sum(planned_qty) = 0, NULL, round(sum(produced_qty) / sum(planned_qty) * 100, 2)) AS yield_pct FROM efn_dwh.v_mo_yield WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(product_name, {{product}}) > 0]]

cards.name: MO di luar ambang
cards.description: Penanda Odoo saat MO selesai (yield < ambang PT atau varians komponen > ambang).
cards.sql: SELECT sum(alert) AS mo_di_luar_ambang FROM efn_dwh.v_mo_yield WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(product_name, {{product}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Varians konsumsi (Rp)
cards.description: Σ (aktual − BoM) x harga pokok. Positif = boros, negatif = hemat/kurang konsumsi.
cards.sql: SELECT sum(variance_value) AS varians_nilai FROM efn_dwh.v_mo_yield WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(product_name, {{product}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Nilai waste harian per alasan
cards.sql: SELECT day, reason_name AS alasan, sum(waste_value) AS nilai_waste FROM efn_dwh.v_waste_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] GROUP BY day, alasan ORDER BY day

cards.name: Waste per gudang vs ambang PT
cards.description: Ambang efn_ck_waste_warn_value per hari (nilai PT saat ini; 0 = nonaktif).
cards.sql: SELECT warehouse_name AS gudang, brand AS pt, sum(waste_value) AS nilai_waste, sum(scraps) AS scrap, max(waste_warn_value) AS ambang_harian, sum(over_threshold) AS hari_di_atas_ambang FROM efn_dwh.v_waste_warehouse_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] GROUP BY gudang, pt ORDER BY nilai_waste DESC LIMIT 200

cards.name: Waste per kategori produk
cards.sql: SELECT category AS kategori, sum(waste_value) AS nilai_waste FROM efn_dwh.v_waste_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] GROUP BY kategori ORDER BY nilai_waste DESC LIMIT 20

cards.name: Yield tertimbang harian per gudang
cards.sql: SELECT day, warehouse_name AS gudang, if(sum(planned_qty) = 0, NULL, round(sum(produced_qty) / sum(planned_qty) * 100, 2)) AS yield_pct FROM efn_dwh.v_mo_yield_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(product_name, {{product}}) > 0]] GROUP BY day, gudang ORDER BY day

cards.name: Yield per produk
cards.sql: SELECT product_name AS produk, warehouse_name AS gudang, sum(mos) AS mo, sum(planned_qty) AS rencana, sum(produced_qty) AS aktual, if(sum(planned_qty) = 0, NULL, round(sum(produced_qty) / sum(planned_qty) * 100, 2)) AS yield_pct, sum(byproduct_qty) AS by_product, sum(variance_value) AS varians_nilai, sum(mos_alert) AS mo_di_luar_ambang FROM efn_dwh.v_mo_yield_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(product_name, {{product}}) > 0]] GROUP BY produk, gudang ORDER BY mo_di_luar_ambang DESC, yield_pct LIMIT 500

cards.name: Komponen dengan varians di luar ambang
cards.description: |varians %| > efn_ck_variance_warn_pct PT (nilai saat ini). Rumus sama dengan laporan varians Odoo.
cards.sql: SELECT day, production_id AS mo_id, finished_product_name AS produk_jadi, component_name AS komponen, warehouse_name AS gudang, expected_qty AS bom, actual_qty AS aktual, variance_qty AS selisih, variance_pct AS varians_pct, variance_value AS varians_nilai FROM efn_dwh.v_mo_component_variance WHERE over_threshold = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(finished_product_name, {{product}}) > 0]] ORDER BY abs(varians_nilai) DESC LIMIT 500

cards.name: MO di luar ambang
cards.sql: SELECT day, production_id AS mo_id, product_name AS produk, warehouse_name AS gudang, planned_qty AS rencana, produced_qty AS aktual, yield_pct, yield_warn_pct AS ambang_yield, byproduct_qty AS by_product, variance_value AS varians_nilai FROM efn_dwh.v_mo_yield WHERE alert = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND brand = upper({{company}})]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(product_name, {{product}}) > 0]] ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 500

cards.name: Kesegaran data ETL
cards.description: Heartbeat ETL (SEC-52). Data dianggap basi bila menit_sejak_sukses > 30.
cards.sql: SELECT job, last_ok_at AS sukses_terakhir_utc, minutes_since_ok AS menit_sejak_sukses, last_status AS status_terakhir, failures_24h AS gagal_24_jam FROM efn_dwh.v_etl_freshness WHERE job IN ('cycle', 'waste_scraps', 'mo_yield', 'mo_components') ORDER BY job
